image_description: A grey whale surfaces in green ocean water, its mottled grey back and dorsal knuckles visible above the waves. In the background, a small boat filled with tourists wearing life vests observes the whale. A person's head and shoulder are visible in the foreground right, looking towards the whale.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The whale's head is submerged or obscured by water spray; only the posterior back and dorsal area are clearly visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin on the whale's back shows characteristic mottling and light-colored patches consistent with barnacle/cyamid infestation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The whale lacks a true dorsal fin. Instead, a series of low humps (knuckles) is visible along the ridge of the back leading to the tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body appears massive and robust, consistent with the scale of a large baleen whale relative to the boat.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the Head_and_Face checkpoint; the texture and coloration match the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is not open, and the interior of the mouth is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pectoral fins are submerged and not visible in this surface-level shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail flukes are submerged or out of frame; only the mid-to-posterior back is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin exhibits a rough, uneven texture consistent with callosities and barnacle attachments.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The water displacement and foam around the whale appear slightly smudged and lack the crisp detail of real hydrodynamic interaction, suggesting minor generative smoothing.

The figures in the boat exhibit slight morphological inconsistencies; faces and limbs are indistinct and somewhat fused, typical of AI generation struggling with small, complex human figures in the background.
The edge of the person's hair and shoulder blends slightly into the background sky/water, indicating minor boundary bleeding.
